notes.title: Free Demo has just Updated!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/5dfd13d02a2aebc8d51eaa974ab2aab4f3012899.gif[/img]

Hello! 
A free update for the demo version with Santa(+Spine animation) has been released!

FYI, Santa appears only in winter!
Use the calendar in the boy's room to quickly warp to winter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/a9cc6b9553dc5d9556b9d79253eecf361769bd8a.png[/img]

And this update also includes several improvements... :


[b]Colored Tileset[/b]
Lots of interactable objects have been redrawn in color!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/fc75bb422a3c44f87926010185f6e95e8225b484.png[/img]


[b]Indoor Light Layer[/b]
To visually feel the time even indoors, a light layer for each period has been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/eaaf3536ec9e42123f49d069339a0ff5c48e7d14.png[/img]


[b]New places, New Characters[/b]
New faces are always welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/7b7461088ea53e6873a15b84b438db4a734abc0f.png[/img]


[b]Thief?[/b]
Find unwelcome guest who only comes at night (not every day though)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/7c2a7cfb5d9914786de923d0fb2d03634552fbf3.png[/img]


[b]X-Ray[/b]
X-Ray artwork has been added to particular H-scenes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/1f59347781188363b486ef9fdf5d2f9233213769.png[/img]


[b]Complete the Album[/b]
Unlocked H-scenes can be played again in CandyBasket.
Check your progress and unlock them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/a5d6113883578681a1a06b85d7c88638424776fa.png[/img]


Thank you very much for your support and patience,
We hope to meet you again with the Full Version, Soon!
Enjoy, please!

notes.title: Vote for the new character
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a while.
As you might already notice, the release of Spooky Milk Life has been delayed.
We're deeply sorry for this situation,
the new release date is TBA but our studio is pushing hard ourselves to make it happen in 2022.

And as an apology, we're planning to update the demo version.
Please vote for characters you want to see in the updated demo version in the link below.
(Google Forms)
https://forms.gle/AUx5kEZbbpZWNUGCA

The vote will be available until 2022-07-27

Thank you for your patience, see you soon!

notes.title: Translators Wanted
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855037/b595aec73c867656d3ed0300e776b10a45c36e52.png[/img]

We created a Weblate site for Spooky Milk Life to improve/add translations.

https://spookymilk.in

Add a new language or fix/suggest better translations on the Weblate.
Participate and start your contribution, your username will be in the game credit!

For whom may not know : 
Weblate is a web-based tool for crowd translation work, used by over 2500 libre projects and companies in more than 165 countries.

Here's a nice tutorial for the beginning :
https://lstn.wolba.ch/weblate/

Also, there're lots of other documents and videos on the internet you can easily find.

Thank you!
